description: 警察署データ [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 全国の警察施設の位置（点）及び警察署の管轄範囲（面）について、名称、施設種別、各警察署単位の管轄区域、所在地等を属性としたGISデータとして整備したものです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2012-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
